Global Nutrition Report ggplot theme

Source: R/03-theme_gnr.R
theme_gnr.Rd

Global Nutrition Report ggplot theme

Usage

theme_gnr(base_size = 11, base_family = "")

Arguments

base_size

Base font size

base_family

Base font family

Value

A ggplot theme

Examples

# Apply theme
theme_gnr()
